_comment: Real values for DESKTOP-HGPP7U3, filled in from the 14 Oct discovery probe. Contains no secrets - safe in the public repo.
_service: The app is ALREADY supervised by NSSM as the service named 'Infuse' (running as .\web, auto-start). The deployer restarts that service rather than creating a new one.
_health: /healthz returns 404 because the app runs remix-serve, not the Amplify-era server.js that defines it. '/' returns a redirect, which counts as healthy (any non-5xx does).
_signing: Probe showed %G? = N (unsigned) on HEAD. Leaving this true would block every deploy. Turn it on only after commit signing is set up AND the public key is in the deploy service account's keyring.
_paths: Absolute, because a Windows service does not inherit an interactive PATH. Verified present by the probe except npmCliJs - confirm with Test-Path before first run.
